# cct dependency

The application is tested with `cct` v1.2.0 for Windows amd64.

The executable is intentionally excluded from Git history. Run `Get-Cct.ps1` from the repository root to download the exact upstream release, verify the archive SHA-256, extract `cct.exe`, verify its SHA-256, and place it in this folder.

Release packages may redistribute the verified executable under its MIT License. Do not replace it with an unverified binary.
